title: Logarithmic bound for the optimality parameter
statement: For each natural number $q$, let $\alpha=1/(q+2)$, and let $\Delta$ be twice the mass of the upper-tail indicator of the normalized sum of uniform signs in a dimension chosen so that its mass approximates $\alpha$ and its level-one Fourier weight approximates the square of the corresponding standard Gaussian density, as specified by the two error bounds. If $\Delta<1$, then $\Delta^2\log(1/\Delta)\leq 9\alpha^2\log(1/\alpha)$.
